stories.title: Canadian poet Anne Carson wins the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature
stories.reason: The Swedish Academy honored her 'bold and inventive oeuvre' blending poetry, essay and classical scholarship, making the 76-year-old Toronto-born writer only the second Canadian woman to win literature's top prize.

stories.title: Hurricane Isaias nears Category 2 strength as it closes in on the US Gulf Coast
stories.reason: The season's first Atlantic hurricane, with winds up to 100mph, is expected to make landfall near Pensacola between Friday night and Saturday morning, prompting storm-surge warnings from Louisiana to Florida and states of emergency in Florida and Alabama.

stories.title: Lithuania's parliament votes to lift its nuclear weapons ban, and the Kremlin warns of escalation
stories.reason: The 106-18 first-reading vote would clear Lithuania's last legal barrier to hosting NATO nuclear deterrence and a potential permanent US base, prompting Kremlin spokesman Peskov to call any such move a step toward 'escalating tensions' near Russia's border.

stories.title: The Trump administration proposes a $70,000 fee for international students' US work authorization
stories.reason: DHS wants universities, not students, to pay the fee for each new Optional Practical Training application plus $30,000 per renewal, a move it frames as fighting visa fraud but that education groups warn could choke off the main pipeline of foreign talent into H-1B jobs.

stories.title: Common Sense Media rates ChatGPT for Teens an 'Unacceptable Risk' for children under 18
stories.reason: Testing over 4,000 prompts found ChatGPT missed more than one in four warranted crisis referrals and sent zero parental alerts across more than a dozen linked accounts, leading the group to urge OpenAI to restrict the product to adults until the gaps are fixed.

stories.title: SpaceX agrees to buy nationwide 800MHz spectrum, sending telecom carrier shares tumbling
stories.reason: The purchase from Grain Management gives Starlink Mobile the low-band coverage Musk called 'the last critical piece' needed to offer complete US phone service, and AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile shares each fell roughly 5-7% on fears of a new wireless rival.

stories.title: Australia's big banks face a parliamentary grilling over their use of AI
stories.reason: Westpac, ANZ and NAB executives are testifying on data security and AI agents, as lawmakers probe deployments like Westpac's region-wide Microsoft Copilot rollout and NAB's AI system that already guides more than 50 million customer interactions a month.

stories.title: Chevron to offload its Hess Midstream stake in a deal halving its Bakken pipeline costs
stories.reason: Chevron will take a one-time loss of roughly $3-4 billion and deconsolidate about $3.7 billion of Hess Midstream debt in exchange for revised contracts expected to cut its Bakken midstream costs by about half going forward.
